hidden.name: Ask the server to check
hidden.title: Sends the selected clip id and listens for progress.
hidden.why: The browser needs the server to rebuild the record.
hidden.here: On a real click the browser posts the clip id to /api/rule and listens for job events. This walk intercepted the request, so no live job was started.

code.plain: The browser posts the id, then opens an event stream for the returned job.
The page listens for queued, stage, result and error events.

hidden.name: Queue one replay
hidden.title: Maps the clip id to its record and starts a replay job.
hidden.why: The page sends an id, not a file path.
hidden.here: The server refuses an unknown id. For a known clip it chooses the record root and runs replay_one for that entry.

code.plain: The server checks the id, builds a replay job and queues it.

hidden.name: Read the saved record
hidden.title: Loads the stored line and its hashed entry.
hidden.why: Replay uses the record made when the ruling was first built.
hidden.here: The replay process reads the entry from the selected record folder. It rebuilds the line from the recorded item, pack, site and pixel facts; it does not decode the original video or call a model again.

code.plain: The process selects the existing line, reads its entry and rebuilds it.
The entry is read from the record folder.
The saved pack and site are loaded, then the rule is rebuilt with model calls off.
Replay disables model calls and video decoding.

hidden.name: Compare the rebuilt ruling
hidden.title: Checks whether the rebuilt line matches the stored line.
hidden.why: The button is a reproducibility check on the saved record.
hidden.here: For this clip the offline rebuild matched the stored line and all four verdicts. The local replay took 17.19 seconds.

code.plain: The rebuilt bytes are compared with the stored line and a result is emitted.

hidden.unsure: The live web request was not run. The match and elapsed time came from the local offline replay.

hidden.name: Show the match
hidden.title: Displays the result and updates each ruling card.
hidden.why: The reader can see whether each stored verdict stayed the same.
hidden.here: The page shows Same ruling. Nobody edited it. If the request fails, it keeps the saved rulings and shows that a live check was unavailable.

code.plain: The result is sealed, then the visible verdicts are compared one by one.
When the request fails the page keeps the stored result and says so.
A matching result gets the plain same-ruling message and rebuilt hash.
Each card shows whether its verdict matches the rebuilt one.

hidden.unsure: The result screen was set by hand from the local offline result; the live button was not pressed.

silent.title: The live request was not sent
silent.text: The result screenshot was filled from the local offline replay output. The local run matched the stored entry and took 17.19 seconds; the page display rounds that to 17.2. No POST was sent to the site.
silent.show: What would the real button send to the server?
